mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AppendOnlyAudit allows the model to produce a DeletedTask with no AuditDeleted entry, directly violating the append-only invariant that audit entries outlive their task row. The injection forces exactly that scenario.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some t: DeletedTask | no ae: AuditEntry | ae.aeTask = t and ae.aeChange = AuditDeleted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_OwnershipBasedAccess allows a MemberRole caller to PATCH a task they do not own, violating FR-009. The injection forces an Operation where a non-owner member patches a task owned by someone else.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OwnershipViolation { some op: Operation, t: ActiveTask | op.opKind = PatchTask and op.opCallerRole = MemberRole and op.opTask = t and t.taskOwner != op.opCaller }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_CrossTeamIsolation allows an Operation to target a task whose team differs from the operation's team context, directly violating the cross-team isolation invariant (FR-014 / SC-004). The injection forces such a cross-team access.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamViolation { some op: Operation, t: ActiveTask, team1: Team, team2: Team | team1 != team2 and op.opTeam = team1 and op.opTask = t and t.taskTeam = team2 }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_MutationOperationsHaveAuditEntry allows a PatchTask operation to complete with no associated MutationEvent (no audit entry), violating FR-015 and SC-007. The injection forces a PatchTask operation with no MutationEvent.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditCompletenessViolation { some op: Operation | op.opKind = PatchTask and (no me: MutationEvent | me.mutOp = op) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_OwnerImmutability allows an AuditCreated entry to record an actor different from the task's owner field, breaking the invariant that owner is set at creation and immutable. The injection forces a task whose owner does not match the creator recorded in the AuditCreated entry.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OwnerImmutabilityViolation { some t: ActiveTask, ae: AuditEntry, u: User | ae.aeTask = t and ae.aeChange = AuditCreated and ae.aeActor != t.taskOwner and t.taskOwner = u }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_PermissionMatrix frees the Allowed relation to contain any (Role, OperationKind) pairs, including granting MemberRole unconditional PatchTask/DeleteTask access, which would falsify LeastPrivilege. The injection adds that forbidden cell.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermissionViolation { MemberRole -> PatchTask in PermMatrix.Allowed and MemberRole -> DeleteTask in PermMatrix.Allowed }
